validation_rule: All required ledger columns must exist
notes: No production ledger can be consumed without the declared column set

required_inputs: production ledger plus record type policy
validation_rule: record_type must be one of the seven approved values
record_id must be present and unique at ledger row grain
Fields forbidden for a record_type must be empty or not_applicable
notes: Examples include verifier timing and control speedup

validation_rule: control_cell rows require control route fields and control denominator join
notes: Controls are checker evidence not rewrite performance rows

validation_rule: rewrite_candidate_cell rows require method candidate fields and Track A join
plan rows require artifact_id plan availability and safe plan path or explicit missingness
portability rows require source_engine target_engine candidate fields and portability status
notes: Must not use same-engine denominator by default

validation_rule: verifier rows require support_pair_id and support status evidence
summary rows require artifact_id retained path and metric_eligible false
notes: Traceability not metric rows by default

required_inputs: production ledger plus public runner policy
validation_rule: user-run rows require user candidate fields and approved output-root paths
Same-engine denominator_id must join the 120 planned scaffold
control denominator_id must join the 360 control scaffold
PORT rows must not silently reuse Track A same-engine IDs
Support-only rows must not carry rewrite metric denominator IDs unless explicitly authorized
notes: Prevents support rows from entering metric denominators

required_inputs: production ledger plus allowed status vocabulary
validation_rule: Status and N.A. fields must use approved values
Obvious inconsistent combinations such as timed true with timing_missing must fail
Generation execution and result-consistency fields must be present before metric computation
Timing and cross-engine fields must be present or explicit N.A. before performance or generalization metrics
Public ledger paths must not expose local absolute paths secrets prompts or raw private traces
Validation must not update reports results case_sets inventory case packages or retained evidence
Ledger metadata must not collapse incompatible record types routes engines methods or denominators
Each row must preserve evidence_source and retained_artifact_path or explicit reason unavailable
notes: Traceability is required for retained evidence

validation_rule: Fixture smoke should pass before production validator changes are trusted
